reason: Existing six summaries may lose initial-peak/curvature information; more complex regressors did not resolve the data limitations. These features summarize exactly the same already approved early observations, not longer cycling or new experiments.
normalization: z=(n-min_early_n)/(max_early_n-min_early_n), only points with n_upper<=declared fraction*N. Halves split at z=.5; each must have>=3 real early points. Otherwise all4 remain missing and old row is preserved. No interpolation/future point borrowing.

formulas.slopes: OLS slope ofR onz separately for each half; expressedpp per observed early span.
formulas.curvature: 2*a2 from degree2 OLS inR=a0+a1*z+a2*z^2; not assumed physical derivative or ground truth.
formulas.peak: z at maximum observed earlyR, first occurrence if tied; graph noise noted, not guaranteed physical activation peak.

deployment_cost: No extra physical measurement beyond approved early window. Software input expands from6 summaries to6+4 summaries and therefore requires discussion before fitting.
validation: If approved, retain six-summary control, same source isolation/author labels/uncertainty; no source filtered by new feature availability or outcome; A/2E histories preserved.
